clips.title: The story
paras: Workers at Alther's Mill cannot send timber to Lakeshire while giant spiders overrun the eastern lumberyard. Foreman Oslow needs the wood to finish the town bridge.

Foreman Oslow is trying to keep bridge repairs on schedule in Lakeshire. Blackrock orcs, gnoll packs, and murlocs along Lake Everstill already strain his workforce. Now giant tarantulas have overrun Alther's Mill to the east, stopping the timber shipments the bridge needs.

Spiders lurk among the timber stacks, leaving the mill useless. Foreman Oslow cannot risk sending laborers into a nest of greater tarantulas, so he hires capable adventurers to clear the spiders and destroy their egg clutches. He is irritated that Alther let the mill fall into disarray, but Lakeshire needs the lumber before the bridge work can continue.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.
Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A bite from one of the tarantulas out here can leave a worker out with a fever for a week. I'd prefer that didn't happen. At least, not on my watch.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.
I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, friend!
